Mary Ann Munce
Preserved Primary Document • munce-m3.htm
Mary Ann "Polly" Munce, the daughter of Isaiah Munce and Elmira Carty was born in Kent Co. Delaware on 1 August,
1859
.
Sometime before
1889
she married Samuel Seeney who was born in October
1853
. They had the following children:

1878
-
1963
) married J. Thomas Mosley
Lola is buried at John Wesley Church in Frederica, DE
